details.value:
Who we are

Faye is the fastest-growing travel protection company in the U.S., and the highest-rated by travelers who use it trip after trip.

We’ve raised $100M to build the autonomous platform for traveler care: insurance, travel care, real-time information, and finance in one place, powered by AI and a team that moves fast.

We’re there for travelers throughout their entire journey, from the moment they book to the moment they’re back home.

The bar is a 6-star experience, 24/7: near-instant payouts, an award-winning app and real support when travel goes sideways. It’s hard to pull off. That’s the point.

Come build what’s next with us.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Assistant Controller who takes ownership and works independently to support and strengthen Faye’s multi-entity (US & Israel) financial operations. You’ll assist with the month-end close, lead major reconciliations, improve systems and automations, and ensure accurate, audit-ready financials as we continue to scale.

details.name: Responsibilities
details.value:
• Support the monthly financial close process, ensuring compliance with US GAAP, including accounts reconciliation, review of journal entries, flux analyses, and other ad hoc corporate requirements.
  • Own and improve reconciliation processes (bank, intercompany, credit cards, commissions, claims, balance sheet).
  • Take end-to-end ownership of key finance processes, including claims and premium reconciliations against payment processors, partner and vendor payments, and procurement.
  • Assist with financial reporting, supporting schedules, and internal controls.
  • Help manage NetSuite, integrations, and automation initiatives to reduce manual work.
  • Use AI tools to automate reconciliations, reporting, and recurring close tasks, and keep finding ways to work more efficiently.
  • Partner with Ops, BD, CX, and Data on finance-related workflows.
  • Manage and execute regulatory tax reporting and Transfer Pricing compliance for both US and Israeli operations.
  • Lead efforts to improve, develop, and document accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 2–4+ years of accounting experience within the technology industry (Must).
  • Big 4 experience (Must).
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to support and improve finance workflows (Must).
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience working with NetSuite and financial integrations (Advantage).
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • High level of ownership, with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive tasks through to completion.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Fluent in both English and Hebrew.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a HR & Office Experience Coordinator to help make our Richmond office a great place to work. If you’re highly organized, proactive, love working with people, and enjoy making things happen, we’d love to meet you!

About The Role: (32 hrs/wk., on-site Mon.- Thurs. in our Richmond, Virginia office)

As our HR & Office Experience Coordinator, you’ll take full ownership of the day-to-day operations of our Richmond office, ensuring a smooth, organized, and welcoming workplace for employees and visitors.

You’ll coordinate and execute employee experience activities in close partnership with our US HR Manager, and provide hands-on administrative and operational support to our VP of Claims & CX and his teams.

You’ll also assist our US HR Manager with administrative tasks related to HR processes as needed.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who takes pride in getting things done, pays attention to the details, and enjoys making a difference in people’s everyday work experience.

details.name: Responsibilities
details.value:
What You'll Do:


Office Operations

  • Own the day-to-day operations of our Richmond office, ensuring everything runs smoothly and the workplace is organized, welcoming, and well-maintained.
  • Manage office supplies, kitchen inventory, snacks, coffee, and other daily essentials.
  • Coordinate mail, deliveries, shipping, office equipment, and general office needs.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for building management, maintenance providers, and local office vendors.
  • Coordinate catering, office purchases, invoices, and other office-related administrative activities.
  • Welcome visitors and help ensure a positive experience for employees and guests.
  • Proactively identify and resolve office-related issues and find ways to improve daily operations.

Employee Experience & HR Administration Support

  • Coordinate and execute employee experience initiatives, events, celebrations, and engagement activities in partnership with the US HR Manager.
  • Take ownership of event logistics and execution, ensuring activities are delivered smoothly from start to finish.
  • Coordinate vendors, catering, supplies, setup, and other event arrangements.
  • Bring ideas and suggestions to improve the office experience while helping turn plans into action.
  • Assist with onboarding and offboarding coordination, including documentation, scheduling, equipment coordination, and other logistics.
  • Support employee records management, HR system updates, and routine administrative tasks.
  • Assist with the coordination and execution of HR processes and initiatives under the guidance of the US HR Manager.

Operational & Administrative Support to VP of Claims & CX

  • Provide hands-on administrative support to the VP of Claims & CX and his teams, including processing Claims & CX-related mail and documents, printing, scanning, shipping, and other recurring operational tasks.
  • Manage recurring administrative activities that support the daily work of the Claims & CX departments.
  • Handle additional administrative and operational tasks based on the VP’s priorities and the evolving needs of both teams.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
What Makes You A Great Fit:

  • 2–4 years of experience in office administration, office management, employee experience, or a similar role.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to solve problems and get things done independently.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a service-oriented mindset and a passion for helping others.
  • Comfortable supporting multiple stakeholders and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable working with Google Workspace, Slack, and other digital tools.
  • Experience coordinating events or employee engagement activities is a plus.
  • Experience working in a fast-growing company or startup is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Our Richmond office runs smoothly, with day-to-day needs handled proactively and independently.
  • Employees and visitors enjoy a welcoming, organized, and positive office environment.
  • Employee events, celebrations, and initiatives are executed smoothly and with attention to detail.
  • The VP of Claims & CX and his teams receive reliable administrative support, reducing time spent on recurring operational tasks.
  • The US HR Manager can focus on her core HR responsibilities, knowing that employee experience activities and administrative tasks are being executed effectively.
  • Office operations and administrative processes become more efficient as Faye continues to grow.

Location & Schedule:

This is a part-time (Monday–Thursday), on-site position based in our Richmond, VA office. Daily office presence is an essential part of the role.

If you’re someone who loves creating great experiences, keeping things organized, and making things happen, we’d love to hear from you!

We’ve raised $100M to build the autonomous platform for traveler care: insurance, travel care, real-time information, and finance in one place, powered by AI and a team that moves fast.

We’re there for travelers throughout their entire journey, from the moment they book to the moment they’re back home.

The bar is a 6-star experience, 24/7: near-instant payouts, an award-winning app and real support when travel goes sideways. It’s hard to pull off. That’s the point.

Come build what’s next with us.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Security Operations (SecOps) specialist to take ownership of our security infrastructure and operations as we scale. In this hands-on, high-impact role, you’ll play a crucial role in managing the infrastructure, services and service providers that help keep Faye secure from outside attacks and insider threats, along with managing our information compliance programs.

details.name: Responsibilities
details.value:
• Support and lead our security programs, both internal and with 3rd party vendors.
  • Lead incident response simulations and continuous vulnerability remediation efforts, optimizing our observability and alerting frameworks.
  • Support the design and maintenance of resilient, scalable cloud infrastructure, ensuring security is baked into the foundation.
  • Work closely with company leadership to ensure adoption of security best practices.
  • Work closely with R&D teams to help them shift security testing left into the early phases of development.
  • Monitor, detect, and respond to security alerts and infrastructure anomalies, optimizing our logging, tracing, and alerting frameworks.
  • Conduct regular reviews of security tools and infrastructure such as endpoint security, malware detection, firewall logs, and the like.
  • Collaborate with our CISO to implement and automate controls supporting fintech/insurtech compliance and data privacy standards (PII protection, SOC2).

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 4+ years experience working in an Incident Response/Cyber Security Operations Center (in-house or outsourced) creating, escalating, and managing security incidents and creating incident reports or 4+ years in either a SecOps or DevSecOps role.
  • Proficient in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or Node.js) to build security guardrails and automate manual processes.
  • 3+ years working with security tools including SIEM, Analytics & Intelligence, Intrusion Detection, Malware Detection, Data Loss Protection, and Identity & Access Management.
  • Experience managing low to high-risk cybersecurity events, alerts, and incidents with event monitoring, analysis, and escalation.
  • A builder’s mindset: You aren't just identifying vulnerabilities; you are designing the automated fixes, guardrails, and processes that prevent them from recurring.

What we're looking for

Faye is redefining travel insurance through a fully digital, data-driven platform that delivers real-time travel care, streamlined claims, and proactive disruption handling.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Developer to help build and scale the core systems powering our products end-to-end. In this role, you’ll take ownership of backend services, design and develop robust, scalable architectures, and work closely with product and engineering teams to solve meaningful challenges that directly impact our customers and partners.

You’ll work with modern technologies including Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS, in a fast-moving environment that values strong engineering fundamentals, a product-driven mindset, and a passion for solving complex problems at scale.

details.name: Responsibilities
details.value:
• Design, develop, and deploy scalable, high-performance backend services that support our web and mobile applications.
  • Own backend features end-to-end: from technical design and implementation to production deployment and ongoing improvements.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented TypeScript code, following best practices, design patterns, and high testing standards.
  • Build and optimize PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and data flows to ensure reliability and performance at scale.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help drive technical decisions that improve velocity, stability, and extensibility.
  • Perform code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and proactively improve system observability, reliability, and performance.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, FE, QA, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into clear technical plans and execution.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Minimum of 6+ years of professional experience in backend development, with a strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Experience working with backend frameworks such as Nest.js or similar frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases and experience with PostgreSQL or similar database technologies.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (e.g., Git), and agile development methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

What we're looking for

Faye is looking for a Senior Product Analyst to help Faye build smarter, move faster, and make better product decisions through data. You’re deeply data-driven and love turning analysis into meaningful business insights that shape strategy and drive impact.

Sitting at the intersection of Product and Data, you’ll own product analytics across the department. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our ﻿customers, products, and business, turn complex data into clear insights, and help Product Managers uncover opportunities, prioritize confidently, and measure what matters.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving startup, with real ownership, high impact, and strong exposure to cross-functional leaders.

details.name: Responsibilities
details.value:
• Become an expert on our products, customers, and business.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers on high-impact questions, and support them with insights and ad hoc data requests.
  • Define, track, and evolve core product KPIs across key journeys and flows.
  • Analyze funnels, cohorts, feature adoption, user behavior, and customer drop-offs.
  • Identify friction points and translate them into clear product and business recommendations.
  • Design and analyze A/B tests and product experiments.
  • Measure the impact of product launches, feature changes, and customer experience improvements.
  • Build dashboards and recurring insights using Tableau, Mixpanel, Snowflake, dbt, and AI tools or LLM engines.
  • Uphold a high bar for rigor and accuracy, so the numbers that reach stakeholders are right and well understood.
  • Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partner with Data and Engineering to improve tracking, event instrumentation, and metric definitions.
  • Take part in the team's effort to bring AI into how we work.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 4+ years of experience in product analytics roles.
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large, real-world datasets.
  • Experience analyzing product funnels, cohorts, customer journeys, and feature usage.
  • Strong understanding of product metrics such as conversion, activation, engagement, retention, usage, and customer satisfaction.
  • Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and product measurement.
  • Experience with tools like Tableau, Mixpanel, dbt, and Snowflake, or similar.
  • A strong sense of rigor and accuracy, and care for data quality and clear metric definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a track record of making data clear and actionable for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to connect product behavior with customer experience and business impact.
  • Comfortable working directly with Product, Data, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Curiosity about using AI to work faster and smarter, and openness to adopting it as part of a team effort.
  • Python or R experience for deeper analysis is a plus.
  • A relevant academic degree or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • Experience in consumer products, travel, insurance, fintech, or customer-facing digital products is a plus.

What makes you a great fit

  • You're curious about how customers behave, not just what the dashboard says.
  • You have exceptional business understanding and naturally connect data to the bigger picture.
  • You move fast, really fast, without compromising accuracy.
  • You know how to turn messy product data into clear decisions.
  • You communicate clearly, challenge assumptions respectfully, and help teams move faster with confidence.
  • You're pragmatic, impact-driven, and excited to help build better travel experiences at scale.
  • You're excited to use AI to work smarter and help shape how we use it across the team.
